what_it_is: TTS-quality cut of IndicVoices: natural speech re-recorded clean. 10,496 speakers, 22 languages.
used_for: Talker training speech (first pick); 10 h per language kept as FLAC for the codec decoder fine-tune (TK1)
keep_rule: train split of our 5 languages; filters; tokens + 60 h FLAC 24 kHz mono
metadata_fields: text lang samples verbatim normalized speaker_id scenario task_name gender age_group job_type qualification area district state occupation utterance_pitch_mean utterance_pitch_std snr c50 speaking_rate cer duration

what_it_is: AI4Bharat's large natural-speech set from 16k+ speakers across districts. Hours on the Hub assumed = 11.2k transcribed (est.).
used_for: Talker training speech (bulk); real conversations for turn-timing statistics
keep_rule: train split of our 5 languages; filters; tokens; timing table from the conversational part
metadata_fields: text duration lang samples verbatim normalized speaker_id scenario task_name gender age_group job_type qualification area district state occupation verification_report unsanitized_verbatim unsanitized_normalized

what_it_is: Read sentences from 1,218 speakers in 12 languages, human-checked.
used_for: Talker training speech (read style, many speakers)
keep_rule: train split of our 5 languages; filters; tokens
metadata_fields: fname text lang duration gender speaker_id

what_it_is: Studio TTS recordings with emotions and styles, ≥ 20 h per speaker.
used_for: Voice-lock candidates for the talker's own voice (PT3)
v01_hours_kept_by_language: hi, bn, mr, ta, te: 20 each
keep_rule: 20 h per language from 1-2 candidate voices; tokens
metadata_fields: filename text language gender style duration wav_path

what_it_is: IIT lecture speech (BhasaAnuvaad). The En-Indic part is Indian-accented English, ~1.6M clips.
used_for: Indian-accented English for the talker
keep_rule: en2indic config only (English audio); filters; tokens; drop translation columns
metadata_fields: text pred_text course_id video_id start_time duration alignment_score hi_text hi_mining_score gu_text gu_mining_score mr_text mr_mining_score ta_text ta_mining_score kn_text kn_mining_score te_text te_mining_score ml_text ml_mining_score pa_text pa_mining_score or_text or_mining_score bn_text bn_mining_score as_text as_mining_score

what_it_is: MUCS 2021 Hindi-English code-mixed speech (community mirror).
used_for: Hinglish talker speech; Hinglish test (its test split)
keep_rule: all of it; test split kept apart for EV
metadata_fields: segment_id transcript speaker_id segment_part ratio_english_words ratio_hindi_words english_words count_english_words count_dev_words ratio_english_words_range

what_it_is: Verified Indic web + PDF text corpus, 22 languages.
used_for: Tokenizer vocabulary merges (TK2)
keep_rule: 300 MB of text per language (6 languages), deduplicated sample

what_it_is: All India Radio news bulletins with transcripts, 12 languages.
used_for: Hindi top-up only if P1 falls short
keep_rule: Hindi only, as needed; tokens

what_it_is: Image-prompted spontaneous speech from many districts, transcribed part.

keep_rule: not in v0.1; dialect top-up later

keep_rule: speech/silence timing table per speaker; no audio, no tokens

what_it_is: Indic instruction-tuning and safety data.
used_for: Thinker spoken-style tuning (PT2)
keep_rule: our 5 languages + English, sampled

what_it_is: 1M synthetic everyday Hinglish conversations (romanised).
used_for: Seed scripts for synthetic Hinglish dialogues (DA2)
keep_rule: all, after a quality spot-check

what_it_is: Google's standard multilingual read-speech benchmark, 102 languages.
